analysis.one_line_summary: Static Black Friday Early Access promotional ad offering 25% off the WavyTalk Whirlwind Curl Airflow Styler and Straightener.
analysis.full_description: A square graphic promotional asset for WavyTalk featuring a Black Friday Early Access campaign. At the top, bold text announces 'IT'S GIVING 25% OFF'. On the right, a smiling blonde model against a purple background holds the light pink Whirlwind Curl tool, showcasing her styled wavy hair. On the left, product copy identifies the 'Whirlwind Curl Airflow Styler and Straightener' alongside a clean cutout shot of the device. Diagonal pink curved ribbon banners frame the corners reading 'BLACK FRIDAY EARLY ACCESS', and the WavyTalk logo is centered at the bottom.
